turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m 56, and over the past year my shortness of breath has been getting worse, along with unintended weight loss. I’m still an active smoker, and I’ve not had fevers, cough, or chest pain.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling or new joint pains. I mostly just feel increasingly short of breath and I’ve been losing weight without trying.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. I’ve mainly just been feeling progressively short of breath and losing weight.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, lifting my arms above my head doesn’t feel particularly difficult—I haven’t noticed any trouble with that. My main issue is the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the unintended weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision or changes like that—no vision problems that come without pain. It’s mainly been my progressively worsening shortness of breath and unintended weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s been so high it feels like you’re burning up—something above 104°F (40°C) that makes you feel extremely hot or dizzy?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any high fevers or felt like I was burning up—nothing like that, and I haven’t been extremely hot or dizzy from fever.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt unusually stressed or overwhelmed—my main problems have been steadily worsening shortness of breath and unintended weight loss over the past year.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate. My symptoms have mainly been the steadily worsening shortness of breath and unintended weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills or felt like I was shaking from feeling cold. It’s mostly just been the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the unintended weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump in your breast that feels firm and hasn’t moved?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump in my breast or anything firm that doesn’t move. My main issues are the steadily worsening shortness of breath and unintended weight loss over the past year.”
